verdict.rationale: ZCode has a plugin page API, so the axis applies. The only related evidence says users can start from an Excalidraw canvas collaboration example to learn about plugin install/update, the page API, and host debugging. That is a sample plugin and a learning entry point, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples. No such reference is documented anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
